name: bbyte-value-negative-test-a1f101c098/byte-value-runtime-negative-v.bal
reason: All essential constructs are supported. Each out-of-range int-to-byte cast (-12, -257, 12345) must panic with NumberConversionError; trap captures it and check returns it from the error? function. The three @output assertions check those returned errors, including the formatted value '12,345'. No applicable subset restriction excludes these cast failures or their error messages.
test_design_notes: io:println is output instrumentation. The case checks runtime conversion failure and error rendering, rather than rejection of invalid byte literals.
